question: **Select the most appropriate option for blank no. 10.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **what**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the proper use of the given WH- words.
 
 
• **'Whose' **is a possessive pronoun. It is used when you're asking or telling to whom something belongs.
 
• **'What' **is used to ask questions and as a pronoun and determiner.
 
• **'Who' **is an interrogative pronoun and a relative pronoun, used primarily to refer to persons.
 
• **'Whom' **functions as an object. We use whom when it is receiving the action.
 
 

 
• As per the use of the given words we can say 'what' is the most appropriate word.
 
• Here, '**what**' is denoting **'the locust plague'**.

Hence, the correct answer is option 2.

Complete Passage: *The locust is an insect that belongs to the family of grasshoppers. These insects are essentially harmless (1) unless__ they meet certain circumstances under which they __(2) become__ more abundant and change their behaviour. India, Pakistan and Iran (__3) are__ currently thinking over the locust plague threat __(4) lingering__ over their economies. When these locusts meet __(5) suitable__ environmental conditions, they become gregarious and __(6) start __breeding abundantly. With their population becoming (7) __denser____,__ they form swarms and keep moving __(8) across__ areas damaging the crops. These swarms attacking __(9) crops__ and thereby devastating the entire agricultural economy is __**(10) what** __is commonly referred to as locust plague. *
